title: Gahori Lau
body:
Gahori Lau is pork cooked with lau, bottle gourd. The gourd soaks up the pork fat and gravy, becoming soft and savoury.

How it is made and served

The gourd is added to the cooked pork and simmered until tender. It makes the dish lighter than a plain pork curry, and it is served with steamed rice.
